1.7.0.title: Improved Timer
features: More ways to customize it, with colors you can tell apart.
Try it from the timer button at the bottom left of the page.

1.6.0.title: Cards and Apple Watch
features: Cards Mode: Swipe through cue cards, one thought each, with a timer.
Cards on Lock Screen: See your cards with the timer and turn them from the Lock Screen.
Apple Watch: Run the teleprompter, turn cards, or keep decks on your wrist.
Action Button: Play or pause the teleprompter without touching the screen.
Help: Tap ? on any screen for tips.

1.5.0.title: Improved with New Features
features: Better sync between the floating window and teleprompter, with smoother scrolling.
See the start countdown directly on the play button.
More text sizes and separate settings for the editor and teleprompter.
